description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartCalculationService, which handles recalculating the total price, discounts, and related summaries for a shopping cart within an e-commerce application. It interfaces with order and shopping cart services, applying validation and ensuring cart state updates.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class responsible for recalculating the shopping cart's total price, discounts, and summary. It includes methods for recalculating cart totals and updating cart state in the database.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates the shopping cart totals including discounts and subtotal, involving validation of inputs, calling order service to compute totals, and updating the shopping cart.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Overloaded method that recalculates shopping cart totals without customer context, primarily used for guest carts or without customer-specific discounts.

methods.name: updateCartModel
methods.description: Persists the updated shopping cart after recalculations by saving or updating it via shoppingCartService.
